summary: Vale S.A. filed a Form 6-K announcing its Board approved a new share buyback program to repurchase up to 100 million common shares (including ADRs), about 2.3% of outstanding shares, over 18 months starting August 19, 2026, after the current program expires. The buyback will occur on stock exchanges at market prices, following Brazilian CVM regulations, and may use financial instruments like equity swaps for synthetic exposure. Management cites confidence in business outlook and capital allocation discipline. The program signals ongoing shareholder value enhancement; watch execution pace and market impact as the company repurchases shares over the period.
